literal: those-who-saw life consuming by-appearance womanly-grace to-innocent-woman battled eyes
translation: The eyes of this innocent, graceful woman look as if they are engaged in battle, with a gaze that consumes the lives of those who look at her.
modern: பார்ப்பவர்களின் உயிரை உண்ணும் தோற்றத்துடன், பெண்மைக்குரிய மென்மை கொண்ட இந்தப் பேதையின் கண்கள் போருக்கு எழுந்தது போல் மாறுபட்டுள்ளன.
explanation: The speaker is captivated and overwhelmed by the beauty of the woman's eyes. He describes her as an innocent woman with natural feminine grace. However, her eyes contrast with this innocence, appearing hostile and ready for battle. This is because her striking gaze has the power to consume the very lives of those who look at her.
